title: Trump sparks debate over diesel export ban
summary: The Trump administration's suggestion that it could ban or limit diesel exports has sparked furious backlash from the American oil industry. Politicians are trying to bring down soaring energy prices ahead of the midterm election in November, but critics say a ban would cause supply problems and higher prices both at home and abroad. Also in this edition - the OECD says the global economy is withstanding the energy shock better than expected, partly thanks to AI investment.

title: Trump administration invites Putin to attend G20 summit in Miami
summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio says summit would be opportunity for Russian president to engage with global leaders.

title: Manchester United losses jump nearly a third to $57m despite record revenue
summary: Manchester United s debt remains over 1 billion pounds ($1.3bn) despite record revenues that are unable to prevent loss.
